tasks.subject: Task 2: Extract ExpectedSchemaExtractor from CreateTableSqlRenderer
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Move CreateTableSqlRenderer's column/type/nullable/PK/FK/index derivation into a structured, reusable ExpectedSchemaExtractor; CreateTableSqlRenderer delegates to it with no behavior change.

**Files:**
- Create: maia-gen/maia-gen-generator/src/main/kotlin/org/maiaframework/gen/schema/ExpectedSchemaExtractor.kt
- Modify: maia-gen/maia-gen-generator/src/main/kotlin/org/maiaframework/gen/renderers/CreateTableSqlRenderer.kt
- Create: maia-gen/maia-gen-generator/src/test/kotlin/org/maiaframework/gen/schema/ExpectedSchemaExtractorTest.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] ExpectedSchemaExtractor.extract(rootEntityHierarchies) returns correct ExpectedTableDef per hierarchy (columns/types/nullable/PK/FK/indexes, including history tables and many-to-many join tables as separate tables).
- [ ] Task 1's CreateTableSqlRendererTest still passes unchanged after the refactor.

**Verify:** ./gradlew :maia-gen:maia-gen-generator:test --tests \"*ExpectedSchemaExtractorTest*\" --tests \"*CreateTableSqlRendererTest*\" -> PASS

```json:metadata
{"files": ["maia-gen/maia-gen-generator/src/main/kotlin/org/maiaframework/gen/schema/ExpectedSchemaExtractor.kt", "maia-gen/maia-gen-generator/src/main/kotlin/org/maiaframework/gen/renderers/CreateTableSqlRenderer.kt", "maia-gen/maia-gen-generator/src/test/kotlin/org/maiaframework/gen/schema/ExpectedSchemaExtractorTest.kt"], "verifyCommand": "./gradlew :maia-gen:maia-gen-generator:test --tests '*ExpectedSchemaExtractorTest*' --tests '*CreateTableSqlRendererTest*'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["ExpectedSchemaExtractor correctly derives columns/PK/FK/indexes", "CreateTableSqlRenderer output unchanged"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: SchemaCheckMain CLI entry point

tasks.subject: Task 9: End-to-end integration test against maia-showcase
tasks.description:
